en: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.
zh: 數千年來，蜜蜂一直是無意識勤勞的象徵。
ja: 何千年もの間、ミツバチは無意識の勤勉さの象徴とされてきました。
local: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.
native: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.

en: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,
zh: 我們總是認為牠們像是生物機器人，
ja: 私たちはいつも彼らを生物学的なロボットのようなものだと考えています。
local: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,
native: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,

en: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,
zh: 注定要步調一致地度過一生，
ja: 彼らは足並みを揃えて生きる運命にあると考えられています。
local: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,
native: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,

en: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.
zh: 被自然賦予的枯燥角色束縛著。
ja: 自然によって割り当てられた退屈な役割に縛られているのです。
local: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.
native: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.

en: This is our first contact story.
zh: 這是我們的首次接觸故事。
ja: これは私たちの最初の接触の物語です。
local: This is our first contact story.
native: This is our first contact story.

en: It happened at a place called Rulinko,
zh: 事情發生在一個叫做魯林科的地方，
ja: それはルリンコという場所で起こりました。
local: It happened at a place called Rulinko,
native: It happened at a place called Rulinko,

en: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.
zh: 在20世紀初的奧地利鄉村。
ja: 1900年代初頭のオーストリアの田舎でのことです。
local: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.
native: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.

en: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,
zh: 從卡爾·馮·弗里施還是孩子時起，
ja: カール・フォン・フリッシュが子供の頃から、
local: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,
native: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,

en: he long to understand what the other animals knew,
zh: 他渴望了解其他動物所知道的，
ja: 彼は他の動物が知っていることを理解したがっていました。
local: he long to understand what the other animals knew,
native: he long to understand what the other animals knew,

en: how they perceived the world.
zh: 牠們如何感知這個世界。
ja: 彼らがどのように世界を認識しているのかを。
local: how they perceived the world.
native: how they perceived the world.

en: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color
zh: 他想知道小魚是否能看到顏色
ja: 彼は小さな魚が色を見ているのか知りたがっていました。
local: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color
native: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color

en: or had a sense of smell.
zh: 或是否有嗅覺。
ja: あるいは嗅覚を持っているのかどうかを。
local: or had a sense of smell.
native: or had a sense of smell.

en: He invented experiments to explore animal experience,
zh: 他發明了實驗來探索動物的感知經驗，
ja: 彼は動物の経験を探るための実験を考案しました。
local: He invented experiments to explore animal experience,
native: He invented experiments to explore animal experience,

en: and he filmed them.
zh: 並且拍攝了這些實驗。
ja: そしてそれらを撮影しました。
local: and he filmed them.
native: and he filmed them.

en: Starting in the early 20th century,
zh: 從20世紀初開始，
ja: 20世紀初頭から、
local: Starting in the early 20th century,
native: Starting in the early 20th century,

en: he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures
zh: 他是第一個使用新興的電影媒介
ja: 彼は新しい映像媒体である映画を初めて使った人物です。
local: he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures
native: he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures

en: to create popular science entertainment and communication.
zh: 來創造普及科學娛樂和傳播。
ja: 科学の普及と娯楽、コミュニケーションのために。
local: to create popular science entertainment and communication.
native: to create popular science entertainment and communication.

en: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.
zh: 數千年來，人類注意到蜜蜂古怪的舞蹈。
ja: 何千年もの間、人間はミツバチの風変わりな踊りに注目してきました。
local: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.
native: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.

en: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect
zh: 但沒有人曾以尊重的態度看待牠們，
ja: しかし、誰もそれらを尊敬の念を持って見たことはありませんでした。
local: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect
native: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect

en: that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.
zh: 認為牠們的舞蹈是有原因的。
ja: 彼らの踊りには理由があると考えたことはなかったのです。
local: that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.
native: that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.

en: Before Carl von Frisch,
zh: 在卡爾·馮·弗里施之前，
ja: カール・フォン・フリッシュ以前は、
local: Before Carl von Frisch,
native: Before Carl von Frisch,

en: no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way
zh: 沒有人曾想過為什麼牠們會這樣移動，
ja: 誰もなぜ彼らがこのように動くのかを考えたことがありませんでした。
local: no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way
native: no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way

en: in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.
zh: 以連續複雜的八字形方式。
ja: 複雑なフィギュアエイトの連続でそのように動くのかを。
local: in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.
native: in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.

en: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture
zh: 馮·弗里施研究了每一個微小的蜜蜂動作，
ja: フォン・フリッシュは小さなミツバチの仕草をすべて研究しました。
local: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture
native: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture

en: and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.
zh: 並被一個無法解釋的謎團吸引。
ja: そして彼は説明できない謎に魅了されました。
local: and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.
native: and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.

en: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee
zh: 他會為蜜蜂擺放一盤糖水，
ja: 彼はミツバチのために砂糖水の皿を用意しました。
local: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee
native: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee

en: from his experimental hive.
zh: 來自他的實驗蜂巢。
ja: 彼の実験用の巣箱からです。
local: from his experimental hive.
native: from his experimental hive.

en: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.
zh: 蜜蜂會先大快朵頤，然後飛回家。
ja: ミツバチはそれを食べてから巣に戻りました。
local: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.
native: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.

en: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.
zh: 被標記的蜜蜂稍後會回來享用美味的糖水。
ja: 印をつけられたミツバチは後で戻ってきて、美味しい砂糖水を飲みました。
local: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.
native: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.

en: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours,
zh: 馮·弗里施注意到，只需幾個小時，
ja: フォン・フリッシュは、わずか数時間で、
local: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours,
native: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours,

en: a multitude of other bees would join her there.
zh: 許多其他蜜蜂會加入她的行列。
ja: 多くの他のミツバチが彼女のところに集まることに気づきました。
local: a multitude of other bees would join her there.
native: a multitude of other bees would join her there.

en: They were always her fellow hive mates.
zh: 牠們總是她的同巢蜜蜂。
ja: それらはいつも彼女の巣仲間でした。
local: They were always her fellow hive mates.
native: They were always her fellow hive mates.

en: But here was the really amazing thing.
zh: 但這裡有件真正令人驚奇的事。
ja: しかし、ここで本当に驚くべきことがありました。
local: But here was the really amazing thing.
native: But here was the really amazing thing.

en: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed
zh: 馮·弗里施知道其他蜜蜂並沒有跟隨
ja: フォン・フリッシュは、他のミツバチが追いかけていないことを知っていました。
local: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed
native: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed

en: the marked bee to the feeding place.
zh: 被標記的蜜蜂到達餵食地點。
ja: 印をつけられたミツバチを餌場まで追っていないのです。
local: the marked bee to the feeding place.
native: the marked bee to the feeding place.

en: How?
zh: 怎麼可能？
ja: どうやって？
local: How?
native: How?

en: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.
zh: 因為他一直密切監視著蜂巢。
ja: 彼は常に巣箱を注意深く監視していたからです。
local: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.
native: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.

en: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey,
zh: 他小心翼翼地使用糖水而非蜂蜜，
ja: 彼は蜂蜜ではなく砂糖水を使うように注意していました。
local: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey,
native: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey,

en: so that the bees' sense of smell
zh: 以免蜜蜂的嗅覺
ja: それはミツバチの嗅覚が
local: so that the bees' sense of smell
native: so that the bees' sense of smell

en: could not guide them to the reward.
zh: 引導牠們找到獎勵。
ja: 報酬の場所を導くことができないようにするためです。
local: could not guide them to the reward.
native: could not guide them to the reward.

en: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away
zh: 他繼續將糖水盤移得很遠，
ja: 彼は砂糖水の皿を遠くに移動し続けました。
local: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away
native: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away

en: until it was several kilometers from the hive.
zh: 直到距離蜂巢數公里。
ja: それは巣箱から数キロメートル離れていました。
local: until it was several kilometers from the hive.
native: until it was several kilometers from the hive.

en: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.
zh: 然而，巢內的蜜蜂仍能找到路。
ja: それでも巣仲間はそこへたどり着くことができました。
local: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.
native: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.

en: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location
zh: 那麼，被標記的蜜蜂如何準確地揭示位置，
ja: では、印をつけられたミツバチはどうやって正確な場所を示したのでしょうか？
local: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location
native: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location

en: of the sugar war with such precision
zh: 糖水的位置如此精確，
ja: 砂糖水の場所をそんなに正確に示したのでしょうか？
local: of the sugar war with such precision
native: of the sugar war with such precision

en: that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?
zh: 以致她的巢內同伴能毫無誤差地找到那裡？
ja: 巣仲間が間違いなくそこへ行けるように？
local: that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?
native: that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?

en: There was a secret message in her choreography.
zh: 她的舞蹈中藏有秘密訊息。
ja: 彼女の振り付けには秘密のメッセージがありました。
local: There was a secret message in her choreography.
native: There was a secret message in her choreography.

en: What had seemed to countless generations of observers
zh: 對無數代觀察者來說看似
ja: 無数の世代の観察者にとっては
local: What had seemed to countless generations of observers
native: What had seemed to countless generations of observers

en: to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions
zh: 不過是毫無意義的痙攣動作，
ja: 意味のない痙攣の動きに過ぎなかったものが、
local: to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions
native: to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions

en: of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,
zh: 一隻愚蠢動物的動作，實際上是一個複雜的訊息，
ja: 愚かな動物の動きだと思われていたものが、実は複雑なメッセージだったのです。
local: of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,
native: of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,

en: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy,
zh: 一個由數學、天文學所啟發的方程式，
ja: 数学や天文学に基づく方程式であり、
local: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy,
native: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy,

en: and an acute knowledge of time.
zh: 以及對時間的敏銳認知。
ja: そして時間に関する鋭い知識を持っていました。
local: and an acute knowledge of time.
native: and an acute knowledge of time.

en: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches
zh: 這些元素綜合起來傳達著財富的位置，
ja: すべてが統合されて、富の場所を伝えていました。
local: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches
native: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches

en: she hoped to share with her sisters.
zh: 她希望與姐妹們分享的地方。
ja: 彼女が姉妹たちと共有したいと願う場所です。
local: she hoped to share with her sisters.
native: she hoped to share with her sisters.

en: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun,
zh: 舞者利用我們的恆星——太陽的角度，
ja: 踊り手は私たちの星である太陽の角度を使って、
local: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun,
native: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun,

en: to indicate the general direction of the food's location.
zh: 指示食物位置的大致方向。
ja: 食べ物の位置のおおよその方向を示しました。
local: to indicate the general direction of the food's location.
native: to indicate the general direction of the food's location.

en: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward,
zh: 馮·弗里施注意到當蜜蜂直線向上舞蹈時，
ja: フォン・フリッシュは、ミツバチがまっすぐ上に踊るとき、
local: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward,
native: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward,

en: she meant fly toward the sun.
zh: 牠的意思是朝向太陽飛去。
ja: それは太陽の方向に飛べという意味でした。
local: she meant fly toward the sun.
native: she meant fly toward the sun.

en: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.
zh: 當牠向下移動時，意思是遠離太陽飛行。
ja: そして下に動くときは、太陽から離れて飛べという意味でした。
local: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.
native: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.

en: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates
zh: 牠左右旋轉傳達食物的精確座標，
ja: 左右に回転する動きで食べ物の正確な座標を伝えました。
local: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates
native: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates

en: in space, sometimes kilometers away.
zh: 在空間中，有時距離數公里。
ja: 空間内で、時には数キロメートル離れた場所を示していました。
local: in space, sometimes kilometers away.
native: in space, sometimes kilometers away.

en: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second,
zh: 牠舞蹈的持續時間，精確到秒的分數，
ja: 彼女の踊りの時間は、秒のごく一部まで正確に示されていました。
local: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second,
native: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second,

en: indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees
zh: 表示她的同伴蜜蜂到達那裡所需的時間長度，
ja: それは仲間のミツバチがそこに到達するのにかかる時間を示していました。
local: indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees
native: indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees

en: to get there.
zh: 到達那裡。
ja: そこに行くのにかかる時間です。
local: to get there.
native: to get there.

en: She even factored in wind speed
zh: 牠甚至考慮了風速，
ja: 彼女は風速も考慮に入れていました。
local: She even factored in wind speed
native: She even factored in wind speed

en: to more finely calibrate the message she danced.
zh: 以更精確地校準她舞蹈所傳達的訊息。
ja: 踊りで伝えるメッセージをより正確に調整するためです。
local: to more finely calibrate the message she danced.
native: to more finely calibrate the message she danced.

en: And this was true at any time of the year
zh: 這在一年中的任何時候都適用，
ja: そしてこれは一年中いつでも当てはまり、
local: And this was true at any time of the year
native: And this was true at any time of the year

en: and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.
zh: 從一個蜂巢到另一個蜂巢，從一個大陸到另一個大陸。
ja: 巣箱から巣箱へ、大陸から大陸へと同じでした。
local: and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.
native: and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.

en: Bees can do the math.
zh: 蜜蜂會算數。
ja: ミツバチは計算ができるのです。
local: Bees can do the math.
native: Bees can do the math.
